etsy.description:
A funny kitchen poster for anyone who is preheated... emotionally. Retro diner-style typography that captures the feeling before the oven is even ready.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• A physical poster print, shipped directly to you
• Available in 11×17 in
• Printed on premium matte paper at 300 DPI

HOW TO USE
Frame and hang in a kitchen, dining room, or home office.

This listing is a physical poster print. Thank you for supporting a small shop!

competitorNotes: Funny kitchen posters on Etsy are dominated by 50s housewife 'I'm Fine' fire scenes; a simple two-word pun stands apart.
Most retro kitchen prints are digital downloads at $3-$6; physical prints are differentiated.
Emotional/preheat wordplay is not present in competitor listings, making this a unique angle.
Amazon funny kitchen posters lean heavily on retro housewife imagery and sarcastic metal tin signs.
Wordplay-based kitchen humor is rare on Amazon; most titles lead with 'Funny Kitchen' and 'Wall Art' or 'Wall Decor'.

research.notes: Picked 'funny kitchen poster' because Etsy has it as an indexed market phrase and it is the broadest high-intent term for this product. 'Preheated emotionally' is unique wordplay unlikely to be searched directly, so it works as a secondary hook in the title rather than the primary keyword.
